# Phase Three — Thirty Further Improvements And Exact File Intent

## Thirty Further Improvements
1. Browser-proof anonymous Radiance before authenticated simulation.
2. Verify the universal launcher appears through real server foundation injection.
3. Check mobile overflow at 390px and a desktop viewport.
4. Check console errors after commerce open.
5. Confirm public action catalog exposes only live handler-backed actions.
6. Confirm planned provider actions stay absent from public capability metadata.
7. Keep Radiance CSS decorative and pointer-transparent.
8. Preserve high-contrast and reduced-motion fallbacks.
9. Generate sitemap in deterministic sorted order.
10. Reject duplicate canonical paths during generation.
11. Reject empty title/description records during readiness.
12. Verify every generated public catalog route resolves to a real product directory or explicit public route.
13. Keep Apps and Games hub entries out of product-card recursion.
14. Keep JavaScript catalogs as the human-authored source and generated server modules as derived artifacts.
15. Add generator freshness tests rather than hand-edit generated shards.
16. Keep telemetry event names stable and documented.
17. Keep telemetry payloads content-free and bounded.
18. Use CustomEvent locally when no server telemetry sink exists, rather than inventing hidden network behavior.
19. Add a pluggable sink adapter only if an existing endpoint already exists.
20. Make telemetry dispatch resilient to missing browser APIs.
21. Measure cold-start stages without logging secrets or database contents.
22. Separate diagnostics from server startup policy.
23. Add a startup summary that identifies the longest stage.
24. Avoid changing initialization ordering unless evidence proves a safe optimization.
25. Add route/readiness reports as JS or Markdown, never JSON.
26. Keep generated source shards under 120 lines.
27. Re-run commerce/Radiance tests after shared UI or SEO transforms change.
28. Re-read every touched file after writing.
29. Write planned-vs-actual completion notes and unresolved risks.
30. Continue immediately into the next safe high-value lane whenever any worker blocks.

## Expected Touch Surfaces
- `geelooy/seo/generatePublicCatalog.mjs` only if generator defects are proven.
- New sitemap generator modules under `geelooy/seo/` using XML output.
- Existing robots text only after full readback if sitemap reference is missing.
- New readiness test modules under focused test directories.
- New privacy-safe telemetry modules under `shared/` if no existing canonical layer exists.
- Small startup timing modules in server runtime only after tracing the real initializer.
- Existing static response/SEO modules only by full-file rewrite after complete reads.
